title: Evals: change contextualization + channel adapters for Console alerting
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem statement:
Teams running evals need high-signal alerts when a model/config change causes a quality regression. Today, Console surfaces raw eval regressions (metric deltas) but lacks contextual correlation to recent config/model changes, leading to noisy alerts, missed root causes, and manual triage. We need: 1) an evals dashboard view that ties regression events to recent config/model rollouts and feature flags, and 2) pluggable alert channel adapters (Slack + PagerDuty) with grouping/dedupe logic that understands rollout windows and can escalate only on sustained regressions.

Goals:
- Present a timeline view that overlays eval metric deltas with model version changes, quantization/profile changes, prompt/template edits, and routing policy flips.
- Surface a correlation score and top suspected change(s) per regression event.
- Deliver alert payloads that include actionable links (diff of config, failing prompt examples, recent rollout batch ids) and recommended remedies (rollback link / runbook).
- Implement server-side dedupe that groups alerts by causal change (not just metric signature) with sticky dedupe windows that respect canary rollouts.
- Channel adapters for Slack (rich blocks) and PagerDuty (service key + dedupe) that support both ephemeral noise suppression and escalation thresholds.

Non-goals:
- Full automated rollback.
- Replacing existing eval regression detection algorithms (this ticket augments alerting and context).
acceptance_criteria: Console evals dashboard shows timeline overlay of metrics + config/model changes for any regression event
Each regression event in Console includes a 'Top Suspected Causes' list with score and links to the exact config diff or model artifact
Slack adapter posts a single grouped message for a correlated regression incident with buttons linking to runbook, rollback guide, and dashboard
PagerDuty adapter creates an incident only when a dedupe/escalation policy triggers (e.g., sustained >3 windows across 2hrs), and includes the causal change id
Server-side dedupe groups alerts by causal-change-key and respects canary windows (canary=true extends sticky-dedupe by rollout window)
Integration tests exist covering: dedupe grouping, canary-aware windowing, Slack block payload anatomy, and PagerDuty incident creation flow

risks: False positives/negatives in correlator could misattribute regression cause; mitigation: show confidence and surface raw diffs for manual confirmation
PagerDuty storms if dedupe logic misses wide-reaching infra-induced regressions; mitigation: circuit-breaker + SRE kill-switch
Data retention: to correlate we need at least 7 days of config audit logs accessible to the correlator service; cost/retention trade-offs required
decisions: Use a scored heuristic correlator instead of full causal inference for MVP (faster to ship, easier to explain in UI)
Slack will use rich blocks with action buttons; we will not send full sample prompt bodies unless user opts-in due to PII risk
PagerDuty will receive minimal incident payloads with a causal_change_key and dashboard link; escalation thresholds are server-configurable per-customer
